DGFT_Schedule_2_Prohibited_Fauna: All wild animals and animal articles (Wildlife Protection Act, 1972)
Peacock tail feathers and handicrafts made thereof
Live exotic birds (including parrots, macaws, ostriches, and emus)
Specific undersized rock and sand lobsters (e.g., Panulirus polyphagus)
DGFT_Schedule_2_Prohibited_Flora_and_Tim: Red Sandalwood / Red Sanders (Pterocarpus santalinus) in log or timber form
SCOMET_Restricted_Dual_Use_Items: Toxic industrial chemicals and chemical weapons precursors
Specialized dual-use alloys and strategic materials
Encryption-enabled electronic devices lacking DoT/MeitY clearance
Antiquities_and_Art_Treasures_Act_1972: Manuscripts and documents older than 75 years
Sculptures, paintings, and historical artifacts older than 100 years
